subs: Speed–time graph: area = distance, slope = acceleration; distance–time graph: slope = speed
Deforms until the internal resisting forces balance the applied load: ΣF = 0, ΣM = 0
Imax, min = (Ixx + Iyy)/2 ± √{[(Ixx − Iyy)/2]² + Ixy²}; product of inertia = 0 about principal axes

Train crossing a bridge or platform
